$comment: Output of security_reviewer.review_security. Sent to the model as the structured output format; every check answered once, citations, severities and fixes are enforced in code (app/modules/design_reviews/rules.py).

summary.description: A few sentences on the overall security posture of the design and what most needs attention.

findings.description: One answer per checklist check, in checklist order.

assessment.description: What the design does about this check, citing design item IDs; for not_applicable, why it does not apply.

recommendation.description: For a gap: the change to the design that would close it. Empty otherwise.

design_items.description: IDs of the design items this answer rests on (required for addressed).

requirements.description: IDs of related requirements, if any.

unverified_capabilities.description: Product or platform capabilities this answer assumes but the inputs do not confirm.

ref.description: REV-n of the review comment answered.
